verdict.rationale: Vestd documents EMI scheme setup and granting options (vestd-docs-14, vestd-docs-15, vestd-docs-6) plus a separate 409A valuation service for UK companies issuing to US taxpayers (vestd-docs-16), showing the building blocks exist, but there is no evidence these are chained into one seamless workflow with an explicit board-approval step. Missing for 10: documented board-approval workflow within the option grant process, and confirmation that 409A valuation is integrated into the same grant flow rather than a separate paid add-on.
